statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band with a narrow flagged window across the quadruple-witching close.
recommendation: Tail sits below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. A narrow flagged window covers 19:45-20:15 UTC, where the quadruple-witching settlement concentrates unwind flow and forecast Tail reaches the WATCH band. CME equity-index futures close the week at 21:00Z, after which no tradable price path remains inside this window. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this mapping.
headline: Nasdaq-100 closes the week near its session high with volatility decaying and the oil supply premium draining
body: NDX trades at 29,545 (+0.33%) inside a 0.64% band of 29,372-29,560 after opening at 29,530, selling off to the low and retracing the entire move to sit roughly fifteen points under the session high. The completed round trip is the decisive structural fact: retracements are finishing rather than failing, so the late drift toward the high is not persistent directional efficiency. VIX at 14.97 is at its own session low, confirming that the protection bid is decaying into the close. Internals conflict rather than align, which argues against a one-way regime: semiconductor equipment is up more than 3% with Micron and Broadcom firm, while application and infrastructure software are lower and the megacap tape is split between Amazon and Alphabet gains and Meta, Microsoft and Apple losses. The macro backdrop stays demanding. The Federal Reserve raised its target range to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September, Chair Warsh characterised the move as removing a dose of accommodation, and October hike pricing firmed through the week, leaving the 10-year Treasury yield pinned at 5.00% against a 2-year near 4.74%. The clearest change since the prior assessment is in energy: WTI has fallen 2.1% to $99.78 and Brent 1.6% to $103.10, a third consecutive down session, after Saudi Arabia signalled it will restore roughly half of the damaged East-West pipeline within days and the full line in about six weeks. That drains rather than resolves the supply premium and eases the energy-to-yields channel, so Stress edges down while staying elevated. Today is the September quadruple-witching expiration, which concentrates unwind and rebalance flow into the 20:00Z cash settlement; the flagged window covers that auction and its immediate aftermath, and it is the only hour in this forecast where Tail reaches the WATCH band. CME equity-index futures then close for the week at 21:00Z, so twenty-two of the twenty-four forecast hours carry no tradable price path and Tail falls to a residual floor representing Sunday-reopen gap exposure.

lookbackSummary: The Thursday afternoon that followed the 16 September Fed hike carried a trend-up mode and Tail of 20-21, mapping to WATCH through 21:00Z. Tail decayed to 17-18 overnight as the mode normalised, then held between 15 and 19 across the Asian and European sessions with the mapped state at EA_ON throughout. The mode ran trend-up through the European morning, then shifted to mixed at 11:00Z as the US session turned two-way, and it has stayed mixed since. Stress climbed from the low 40s to around 50 on crude above $100 and the 10-year pressing 5%, peaking at 51 in the early US afternoon before easing as oil fell for a third session. All 24 lookback hours are covered by published assessments.
outlookSummary: The final cash hour is expected to hold inside its band under expiration pinning, with the narrow flagged window at 19:45-20:15 UTC covering the quadruple-witching settlement and its unwind, where forecast Tail peaks at 21 and the mapped state is WATCH for that hour only. CME equity-index futures then close for the week at 21:00Z, so the final twenty-two hours of the window carry no tradable price path; forecast Tail settles at a residual 11-13 and drifts up slowly as unpriced weekend headline exposure accumulates toward the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, which falls outside this window. Confidence decays from 85 to 70 across the halt because no fresh price-path evidence can arrive. The Saudi East-West pipeline restoration timeline and the signalled further Fed tightening are the stored conditionals for Monday, whose first calendar items are a Fed Goolsbee speech at 10:30Z and the Chicago Fed activity index at 12:30Z.
